Hawaii Packing List
Emma Johnson - June 10-20, 2024

CLOTHING
- Swimwear (2-3 suits for beach days, snorkeling, kayaking)
- Casual outfits (7-10 days worth)
- Lightweight cover-up for beach
- Shorts and t-shirts
- Evening casual wear (for Luau)
- Light jacket or sweater (for air-conditioned places)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/water shoes
- Hiking shoes (for Diamond Head hike)
- Sleepwear

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Aloe vera gel (after-sun care)
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Sunglasses
- Hat (wide-brimmed for sun protection)
- Snorkeling mask (optional, can rent)
- Waterproof phone case
- Reusable water bottle

OUTDOOR & SIGHTSEEING
- Hiking gear (comfortable clothes, good shoes)
- Daypack or small backpack
- Camera
- Binoculars (optional)

TRAVEL ESSENTIALS
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapters (if needed)

HEALTH & TOILETRIES
- Prescription medications
- Pain relievers
- Motion sickness medication (for road trips)
- Basic first aid kit
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Shampoo and conditioner (travel size)
- Skincare products
- Lip balm with SPF
- Insect repellent

TECH & ENTERTAINMENT
- Headphones
- E-reader or books
- Travel pillow and eye mask

ACTIVITIES REMINDER
- June 11: Beach day at Waikiki Beach
- June 12: Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- June 13: Hiking at Diamond Head
- June 14: Visit to Pearl Harbor
- June 15: Road trip to the North Shore
- June 16: Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center
- June 17: Hotel spa day
- June 18: Kayaking at Kailua Beach
- June 19: Shopping at Ala Moana Center
- June 20: Departure
